basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and hobbyist from Detroit, Michigan. Passionate about robotics, especially LEGO Mindstorms, and enjoys exploring unique discussions on Reddit. As a software engineer by profession, I work flexible hours which allows me to stay active online during late evenings and weekends. I appreciate intelligent conversations and am always on the lookout for insightful debates. Single and content, I enjoy the sugar lifestyle as a way to meet interesting people. I dislike poor communication and lack of punctuality.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade working in software development, I have honed my skills in coding and robotics. Self-taught in several programming languages, I often share my insights on technology forums and engage in discussions about advancements in robotics and AI.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: strict, with a focus on maintaining respectful and constructive dialogues. I actively report spam and inappropriate content to help keep subreddits clean and on-topic.
